Negative Acknowledgement — payment file status indicating the file was rejected by the receiving system. Maps to the code NACK in payment_file.status.
Chilean Peso — the currency of Chile. A valid value for payment_file.total_currency.
The proportion of payment transactions processed end-to-end without any manual touchpoint, expressed as a percentage. Sourced from payment_hub_throughput.stp_rate_pct.
The elapsed time (in minutes) taken to resolve a payment exception from creation to closure. Sourced from payment_exception.resolution_time_minutes.
The category or classification of a payment exception, describing the nature of the error or issue encountered. Sourced from payment_exception.exception_type.
The number of individual payment transactions contained within a payment file. Sourced from payment_file.total_count.
The total monetary value of all payments within a single payment file. Sourced from payment_file.total_amount.
The underlying network or channel over which a payment is cleared and settled (e.g. WIRE, ACH, SEPA_CT, RTP). Sourced from payment_hub_throughput.payment_rail.
The current processing state of a payment file in the hub (SENT, RECEIVED, or NACK). Sourced from payment_file.status.
The date and time at which a payment exception was closed or resolved. Sourced from payment_exception.resolved_at.
The proportion of transfers that completed successfully, mapped to transfer.success_rate. Also referred to by users as approval rate, completion rate, pass rate, acceptance rate, or hit rate.
The proportion of transfers that required manual repair or correction, mapped to transfer.repair_rate. A high repair rate indicates processing exceptions and STP failures.
The monetary value of a transfer or payment, mapped to transfer.txn_value or transfer.amount. Users may say payment value, transfer value, total value, or transaction amount.

The number of individual transfers or payments processed, mapped to transfer.txn_count or payment_hub_throughput.volume_count. Users may say payment count, number of transactions, transfer count, or volume.
The total monetary value of payments processed through the payment hub, mapped to payment_hub_throughput.value_amount. Users may say payment value, settlement amount, or total value.
A unique identifier for a transfer or payment, mapped to transfer.reference. Users may say transfer reference, transaction reference, reference number, or payment ID.

0.description: Returns the sum of all bank account balances across every account as of the most recent completed day.
cte_steps: yesterday_snapshots: filter BalanceSnapshot to records where statement_date equals yesterday's date
final: sum the amount field across all filtered rows to produce a single total cash balance figure
required_aggregations: Sum of balance amounts across all accounts
required_filters: Statement date equals yesterday

1.description: Returns the daily closing balance for the JPMorgan operating account for each of the last 7 calendar days.
cte_steps: jpmorgan_account: join BalanceSnapshot to Bank to identify accounts belonging to JPMorgan and filter to the operating account type
final: filter the joined result to the last 7 days and return the balance amount for each statement date ordered chronologically
required_aggregations: Closing balance amount per day
required_filters: Bank name matches JPMorgan
Account type or name matches operating account
Statement date is within the last 7 calendar days

2.description: Returns a list of individual wire transfer payment transactions processed today where the transaction amount exceeds one million.
cte_steps: todays_wires: filter PaymentTransaction to records where the execution date is today, the payment type is wire, and the amount is greater than 1,000,000
final: return the relevant transaction details such as reference, amount, currency, and status for each qualifying wire transfer
required_aggregations: Count of qualifying wire transfers
List of individual transaction details
required_filters: Execution date equals today
Payment type or rail is wire transfer
Transaction amount greater than 1,000,000

3.description: Returns all bank accounts that recorded a negative balance on any day during the current week.
cte_steps: this_week_balances: filter BalanceSnapshot to records where the statement date falls within the current calendar week and the balance amount is less than zero
final: join to BankAccount to enrich with account details and return distinct accounts with their most recent negative balance amount and date
required_aggregations: Identification of accounts with at least one negative balance reading this week
required_filters: Statement date falls within the current week
Balance amount is less than zero

4.description: Returns the total value of ACH receipt transactions received and processed yesterday.
cte_steps: ach_receipts_yesterday: filter PaymentTransaction or PaymentHubThroughput to records where the payment rail is ACH, the direction is inbound or receipt, and the date is yesterday
final: sum the transaction amounts to produce the total ACH receipt value for yesterday
required_aggregations: Sum of ACH inbound transaction amounts
required_filters: Payment rail equals ACH
Transaction direction is inbound or receipt
Transaction date equals yesterday

5.description: Returns all bank accounts grouped and counted by their currency denomination.
cte_steps: accounts_with_currency: retrieve all bank accounts from BankAccount along with their associated currency code
final: group accounts by currency code and return the currency name along with the count of accounts for each currency
required_aggregations: Count of bank accounts per currency

6.description: Returns the count of open bank accounts located in Canada.
cte_steps: canada_accounts: join BankAccount to BankBranch and filter to branches where the country code is Canada and account status is open or active
final: count the number of qualifying accounts and return the total
required_aggregations: Count of open bank accounts in Canada
required_filters: Country equals Canada
Account status is open or active

7.description: Returns a daily cash position summary for each bank account showing balances as of last Friday.
cte_steps: last_friday_snapshots: filter BalanceSnapshot to records where the statement date equals the most recent Friday
final: join to BankAccount to enrich with account name and currency, and return one row per account with its balance as of last Friday
required_aggregations: Balance amount per account as of last Friday
required_filters: Statement date equals last Friday

8.description: Returns the most recent spot FX rate for the USD to CAD currency pair stored in the system.
cte_steps: usd_cad_rate: filter FxRate to records where the base currency is USD, the quote currency is CAD, and the rate type is SPOT, then order by rate date descending
final: return the most recent rate record including the rate value and the date it was published
required_aggregations: Most recent rate value for USD/CAD spot
required_filters: Base currency equals USD
Quote currency equals CAD
Rate type equals SPOT

9.description: Returns a comparison of forecasted versus actual cash inflows by legal entity for the past 30 days, flagging cases where the variance exceeds 10 percent.
cte_steps: recent_period: define the date range as the last 30 days from today for use as a filter across subsequent CTEs
actuals_by_entity: aggregate actual cash inflow amounts from ForecastActual by legal entity and period date within the last 30 days
forecasts_by_entity: aggregate forecasted inflow amounts from ForecastLine or CashForecast by legal entity and forecast date within the same window
entity_lookup: join Company to resolve entity references into human-readable legal entity names
variance_calc: join actuals and forecasts by entity and period, compute the absolute and percentage variance between forecast and actual amounts
final: filter to rows where absolute percentage variance exceeds 10 percent, enrich with entity names, and return sorted by variance magnitude descending
required_aggregations: Sum of actual cash inflows per entity per period
Sum of forecasted cash inflows per entity per period
Absolute variance amount between forecast and actual
Percentage variance between forecast and actual
required_filters: Period or forecast date is within the last 30 days
Flow direction is inbound or inflow
Percentage variance is greater than 10 percent

30.description: Lists all outstanding debt drawdowns with their principal amounts, currencies, and repayment dates falling within the next 90 days.
cte_steps: upcoming_maturities: filter DebtMaturity to rows where status is OUTSTANDING and repayment_date falls within the next 90 days from today
facility_details: join Bond to enrich each maturity with facility code, currency, and commitment amount for display
required_aggregations: Sum of principal_amount grouped by currency
Count of maturing drawdowns
required_filters: Status = OUTSTANDING
Repayment date is within the next 90 calendar days from current date

31.description: Returns all letters of credit with an OPEN status, showing their LC number, face amount, drawn amount, issuer, and expiration date.
cte_steps: open_lcs: filter LetterOfCredit to rows where status is OPEN
lc_summary: select LC number, face amount, drawn amount, currency, issue date, and expiration date from open_lcs ordered by expiration date ascending
required_aggregations: Sum of face_amount across all open LCs
Sum of drawn_amount across all open LCs
required_filters: Status = OPEN

32.description: Calculates the remaining available borrowing capacity under revolving credit facilities by subtracting total outstanding drawdowns from committed amounts.
cte_steps: rcf_facilities: filter Bond to revolving credit facility type records with an active or available status
outstanding_drawdowns: aggregate DebtMaturity by facility_ref summing principal_amount where status is OUTSTANDING
available_capacity: join rcf_facilities to outstanding_drawdowns and compute commitment_amount minus total outstanding principal as available capacity
required_aggregations: Sum of principal_amount grouped by facility_ref for outstanding drawdowns
Commitment_amount minus total outstanding principal to derive available capacity per facility
required_filters: Facility type is revolving credit (RCF or similar)
Drawdown status = OUTSTANDING

33.description: Shows the net cash position aggregated by geographic region for the current week, derived from daily balance snapshots linked to bank accounts and branches.
cte_steps: current_week_snapshots: filter BalanceSnapshot to rows where statement_date falls within the current calendar week
account_region_mapping: join BankAccount to BankBranch to resolve each account's geographic region
net_cash_by_region: join current_week_snapshots to account_region_mapping and sum balance amounts grouped by region
required_aggregations: Sum of balance amount grouped by region
Count of accounts per region
required_filters: Statement date is within the current calendar week
Validation flag = PASSED (optional quality filter)

34.description: Returns the total notional amount of all active (OPEN/ACTIVE) FX hedge positions and FX forward contracts outstanding, broken down by currency.
cte_steps: active_hedge_positions: filter HedgePosition to rows where status is ACTIVE and sum notional_amount by currency
open_fx_forwards: filter FxForward to rows where status is OPEN and sum notional by currency
combined_notional: union or join both CTEs and compute total outstanding notional by currency
required_aggregations: Sum of notional_amount from HedgePosition grouped by currency where status is ACTIVE
Sum of notional from FxForward grouped by currency where status is OPEN
Grand total notional across both instruments
required_filters: HedgePosition status = ACTIVE
FxForward status = OPEN

35.description: Lists all investment positions whose instruments have a maturity date within the next 30 days, along with book value, face amount, yield to maturity, and instrument details.
cte_steps: maturing_instruments: filter InvestmentInstrument to rows where maturity_date is within the next 30 days from today
positions_snapshot: join InvestmentPosition to maturing_instruments on instrument_ref to get the most recent position snapshot
maturing_positions: select instrument details, book value, face amount, yield to maturity, and maturity date ordered by maturity date ascending
required_aggregations: Sum of book_value for maturing positions
Sum of face_amount for maturing positions
Count of positions maturing within 30 days
required_filters: Instrument maturity_date is within 30 calendar days from current date
Position snapshot is the most recent available

36.description: Shows covenant compliance status for all active credit facilities by comparing current financial metrics against policy thresholds embedded in facility terms.
cte_steps: active_facilities: filter Bond to facilities with active or available status
outstanding_drawdowns: aggregate DebtMaturity by facility_ref to compute total drawn amount and utilisation
latest_financials: retrieve the most recent CompanyFinancialMetric snapshot for key ratios such as debt_to_ebitda
compliance_check: join active_facilities to outstanding_drawdowns and latest_financials, compare utilisation and financial ratios to thresholds, flag breaches
compliance_summary: return facility code, commitment amount, drawn amount, utilisation pct, key covenant ratios, and compliance status per facility
required_aggregations: Sum of principal_amount grouped by facility_ref for drawn amounts
Utilisation percentage as drawn divided by commitment amount
Latest debt_to_ebitda ratio from CompanyFinancialMetric
required_filters: Facility status is active or available
Most recent period for CompanyFinancialMetric

37.description: Returns the total principal outstanding and weighted average all-in interest rate for all commercial paper drawdowns that are currently outstanding.
cte_steps: cp_facilities: filter Bond to commercial paper facility types
